name.ja: ＨＧ 1/144 イオフレーム獅電改（流星号）

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ』より、イオフレーム獅電改（流星号）がＨＧシリーズキットで登場！
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam Iron-Blooded Orphans", Ioframe Shiden Kai (Ryusei-go) is now available as an HG series kit!

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ』から、イオフレーム獅電改（流星号）をＨＧシリーズキットで商品化。
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam Iron-Blooded Orphans", the Ioframe Shiden Kai (Ryusei-go) is commercialized as an HG series kit.

description.ja: 特徴的な機体色を成形色で再現し、頭部・肩部の形状は新規造形で再現。
description.en: The characteristic body color is reproduced with molding color, and the shape of the head and shoulders are reproduced with new molding.

description.ja: ●　流星号の形状を新規造形で再現！
description.en: ●Reproduce the shape of Ryusei-go with new modeling!

description.ja: 頭部・肩部の形状を新規造形で再現。また、特徴的な流星号の機体色を成形色で再現。
description.en: The shape of the head and shoulders is reproduced with new modeling. In addition, the characteristic Ryusei-go aircraft color is reproduced with molded color.

description.ja: 流星号の特徴である頭部のツノは、新規造形で再現。目を思わせるような装飾を再現する、ホイルシールが付属。
description.en: The horns on the head of the Ryusei-go are reproduced with new modeling. Comes with a foil seal that reproduces the decoration reminiscent of eyes.

description.ja: バイザーを上げた際の内部構造も再現。
description.en: The internal structure when the visor is raised is also reproduced.

description.ja: 両肩のスラスターを新規造形で再現。
description.en: The thrusters on both shoulders are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ●　ディスプレイの幅が広がる、パルチザン、ライフルが付属！
description.en: ● Partisan and rifles are included to expand the display!

description.ja: パルチザンは腰部分に携行可能。
description.en: Partisan can be carried on the waist.

description.ja: ●　広範囲な可動域により、劇中の様々なアクションを再現可能！
description.en: ● Wide range of motion allows you to reproduce various actions in the play!

description.ja: 付属武装 ： パルチザン　／ ライフル　／ ガントレットシールド
description.en: Attached weapons: Partisan / Rifle / Gauntlet Seal

description.ja: １／１４４スケール組み立て式プラモデル
description.en: 1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model

description.ja: 対象年齢：８才以上
description.en: Target age: 8 years old and above

description.ja: 製品素材：ＰＳ・ＰＥ
